response.guide: When section is omitted, table_of_contents is populated and section is absent — pick a section id and call get_sec_filing again with that id. When section is provided, section is populated and table_of_contents is absent. Section content can be several thousand tokens for narrative sections (e.g. MD&A); prefer fetching one section at a time. If the filing has not yet been processed or the section id did not match, an error will be returned.
